reference.note: RCSB builds these from the mmCIF _pdbx_struct_oper_list. We build from either deposited form. The PDB arm is an independent reading of the same annotation; the mmCIF arm reads the same matrices RCSB does and so isolates the builder from the parser.

structures.why: In the bundled receptor catalogue and flagged needs_generated_copies. The mu-opioid receptor: its pocket sits INSIDE the monomer, so building must not move a docking result. The control for the live check, and the reason the catalogue cannot be the gate.

The per-BIOMOLECULE operator-id scoping case. Its operator 2 translates by +14.85678 in assembly 1 and by -27.24922 in assembly 2; reading the ids globally placed a chain 42 A from where the depositor put it. This is that bug's external witness.
The third catalogue entry holding LESS than its biological unit. Included so the gate covers every curated receptor that needs generated copies, not a sample of them.

A GENERAL ROTATION, deliberately. Maltoporin's trimer is a 3-fold, so its matrix is dense and asymmetric -- every catalogue matrix is axis-aligned, which means a transposed implementation passes all 49 deposits. This is the only entry whose transpose is a different structure, so it is the only one that can catch it.

60 operators on a satellite tobacco mosaic virus asymmetric unit. The builder REFUSES it over the atom limit, and RCSB's own assembly confirms the count it refuses on is right to the atom. A refusal branch that nothing external checks is a branch that can drift.

THE PRODUCT EXPRESSION, and the only one in reach that can be checked against real coordinates. Two groups, the second carrying a range AND a comma list, expanding to 15 placements over 8 chains. Scored as a SUBSET of assembly 1 because RCSB pre-generates only assembly 1 for this entry, and 1-10,21-25 are 15 of that assembly's 60 operators; measured, all 52,110 of our atoms appear in their 208,440. mmCIF only -- REMARK 350 has no expression syntax, so the PDB form of this deposit cannot state a product at all. atom_limit is raised because the 100,000 default is a DOCKING preparation guard and this entry exists to check coordinates, not that guard; 1A34 assembly 1 above is what checks the guard.
structures.why_not_composition_order: Its outer group is X0, which this deposit defines as the exact identity, so composing X0 with k gives k in either order. The entry covers product PARSING and the placement set; it cannot catch a reversed composition. Every product expression whose outer group is non-identity (1M4X assembly 7 (P)(61-88), 1AL0 assembly 6, 1NOV assembly 6) lives in an assembly RCSB does not pre-generate, and the one product that IS in a served assembly, 1M4X assembly 1 (1-60)(61-88), is 16,284,240 atoms. So composition ORDER has no external witness and stays unit-tested; see test_assembly_gate.py, which asserts that gap is declared rather than forgotten.
